versions.subject: rule: suspicious vss ps load
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName:
        - 'VSS_PS.DLL'
filter:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\svchost.exe'
        - '\msiexec.exe'
        - '\vssvc.exe'
        - '\srtasks.exe'
        - '\tiworker.exe'
        - '\dllhost.exe'
        - '\searchindexer.exe'
        - 'dismhost.exe'
        - 'taskhostw.exe'
    Image|contains: 'c:\windows\'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="VSS_PS.DLL" NOT (Image IN ("*\\svchost.exe", "*\\msiexec.exe", "*\\vssvc.exe", "*\\srtasks.exe", "*\\tiworker.exe", "*\\dllhost.exe", "*\\searchindexer.exe", "*dismhost.exe", "*taskhostw.exe") Image="*c:\\windows\\*")
